'''Ethen Wessiri''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] citizen of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] during the [[Galactic War]]. Around [[3640 BBY]] he was on [[Voss]], where he discovered that the [[Gormak/Legends|Gormak]] converted several monoliths in the [[Pelath-Ri Marches]] into the relay stations, allowing them to coordinate their attacks against the Republic. Ethen asked a Republic agent in the area to destroy those relay stations.<ref name="SWTOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Ethen Wessiri appears in the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' as an NPC on Voss, who begins the mission "Silencing the Gormak."
